facts.fact: Phase II of the Smart Zambia National ICT Development Project, under a $392 million commercial contract with Huawei financed by a China Eximbank buyer's credit signed 28 Dec 2017, extends the ZESCO national optical fibre backbone by 2,700 km covering 64 backbone sites; the document says Phase II commenced in May 2017, though the loan was 0% disbursed as of July 2022.
